inspection.method: Git history and GitHub PR, timeline, check, and Actions records
inspection.causal_boundary: Timeline removal is an observed service-loss event; it is not by itself proof of the named root cause.

queue_baseline.interpretation: Measured removal history is a service-rate-loss signal, not evidence that one check caused every removal.

symptoms: An unchanged source-health projection could change at an evaluation-time freshness boundary.
Offset-less source timestamps could serialize differently under UTC and America/New_York.
signature.match_rule: A source-health public-projection result changes across evaluation time or build timezone without source/config drift.

affected_checks.name: Unit tests (site + worker)
affected_checks.role: required check containing the source-health regression suite

detection_story.summary: PR #1331 describes the merge-path jam and adds a 48-hour fake-clock test plus UTC/New York byte-identity coverage. The public timeline shows pre-fix queue removals followed by re-service for PRs #1317 and #1323; those events establish repeated service loss, not check-specific causation.
detection_story.attribution: inference anchored by the fix PR; the public timeline does not expose a per-removal failed-check payload

root_cause.summary: Evidence hashes and freshness labels depended on evaluation time, and offset-less source timestamps were not normalized as UTC. The result was a deterministic-gate failure caused by the clock or build timezone rather than by a source/config change.

fix_pr.title: Make source health projection checks deterministic

time_to_detection.basis: First observed pre-fix removal in the affected timeline to the first public fix commit; the removal is a proxy signal, not a directly timestamped source-health failure.

time_to_fix.basis: Public commit timestamp to public merge timestamp.

symptoms: TypeError: globalThis.renderRulesExplorer is not a function
The failure occurs when the accessibility shard invokes renderRulesExplorer before the route module is ready.
signature.match_rule: The browser-a11y shard fails at renderRulesExplorer readiness/module loading, while other accessibility states pass.

affected_checks.name: Accessibility + language gate (axe on every PR)
affected_checks.role: aggregate required check that propagated the shard failure

detection_story.summary: The first public failure receipt records the exact renderRulesExplorer TypeError at 2026-08-27T19:03:27Z on run 33104958413. The same signature recurs at 2026-08-27T23:28:01Z on merge-group run 33124737622; the failed aggregate reports the browser-a11y shard while the other listed shards pass.
detection_story.attribution: measured signature recurrence plus timeline correlation; a shard failure alone is not proof of a root cause

root_cause.summary: The accessibility harness exercised a route-specific renderer before the application had completed loading its module graph. PR #1347 moves the check behind completed application boot and adds a structural ordering assertion, identifying the race as module readiness rather than an accessibility violation.

fix_pr.title: Wait for route modules before accessibility checks

time_to_detection.basis: The failed-run log timestamp is the detection receipt for the exact signature.

time_to_fix.basis: First exact-signature log timestamp to the root-fix commit timestamp; merge completion was 273.9667 minutes after detection at 2026-08-28T03:37:25Z.

taxonomy.label: Arm-time thrash
taxonomy.service_rate_mechanism: Repeated arm, update, and re-arm transitions consume attempts without a successful dequeue.

taxonomy.label: Flaky-shard ejection
taxonomy.service_rate_mechanism: A transient shard failure discards a service attempt and returns the PR to the queue.

taxonomy.label: Generated-file conflict
taxonomy.service_rate_mechanism: Shared generated outputs make otherwise independent changes collide and require rework.

taxonomy.label: Live-external coupling
taxonomy.service_rate_mechanism: A gate depends on mutable production, credentials, or external data.

taxonomy.label: Long-pole serial check
taxonomy.service_rate_mechanism: A serial check sets a service-time floor even when observations are independent or irrelevant.

taxonomy.label: Runner-pool contention
taxonomy.service_rate_mechanism: A saturated hosted-runner pool stretches shard wall time and reduces completed trains.

taxonomy.label: Shared-gate rot
taxonomy.service_rate_mechanism: A valid change becomes red after time, timezone, or baseline movement and must be serviced again.

fixture_contract.deterministic_sort: incidents by id; history_records by class then ref; taxonomy by id
fixture_contract.causal_claim_rule: Every root_cause and attribution claim must carry evidence_refs and evidence_kind or attribution.
fixture_contract.receipt: A validator must emit a canonical JSON receipt from this contract without using wall-clock time.
